magma_isomorphism_semantics.source: Magma V2.29 handbook, elliptic-curve morphisms / IsomorphismData

inverse_map_structural_identity.selected_origin_cases: J_q origin maps to the selected K base point: t=1 for d=1 and t=0 for d=2

finite_reduction_rule: At a prime where all locked coefficients reduce and both curves have good reduction, reduce the certified J_q point, invert [r,s,t,u] to the Magma elliptic model, form [T:S], and compare the resulting projective receiver-x with the reduction of the E_q point. If one chosen coordinate presentation becomes [0:0] modulo p, retain that J-state conservatively rather than using it for elimination.
